scores.scale: 0 unusable, 5 mixed/functional with substantial friction, 7 good with clear limitations, 10 exceptional consistently comfortable. Scores reflect observed emulated mobile interaction, not win/loss or an average of outcomes.

reasons.overallMobile: Coherent complete mission with unusually legible contextual navigation assistance and useful combat feedback. Portrait crowding and tiny distant threats hold it back. Confidence limited by short assisted, paused play.
reasons.controls: Two-contact MOVE and FIRE drag registered and downed patrols; scene swipe, AIM and DASH responded. Tap aim support strong. Drag sample small; long manual tracking and continuous rearming unassessed.
reasons.gameplay: Recoveries, different coil sight lines, timed openings and final deck defense formed a readable progression. Needed correction for cover and depleted magazine. Extensive route/tap assistance prevents strong conclusions about unaided challenge or extended enjoyment.
reasons.presentation: Consistent cyan/amber industrial rain atmosphere, restrained typography, striking title and readable terminal layout. Software rendering cannot certify hardware visual/performance experience.
reasons.usability: Contextual HOLD APPROACH, route assists, visible threat turns, map and explicit upload stay instruction were helpful. Repositioning for final coil was learnable. Some cues compete for attention.
reasons.readability: Large health/ammo, objective checks, target-down and coil percentages worked. Small distant patrols and dim fine text were harder; lower HUD occupies much of portrait area.

unassessed: Physical phones, Safari, audio, hardware performance, touch ergonomics on glass, continuous enjoyment
Extended unaided movement/tracking and continuous held-burst rearming
Recovered memory content, KIT tools, settings, jumping; no enjoyment inferred for these

method.sourcePolicy: Only helper --help read; no game source/tests/docs/prior reviews/recordings/internal state/target metadata inspected. Visible screenshots and UI used.
method.projection: AIM cleared on pause. After attempt1 first zoom capture an empty resume/capture refreshed normal projection before navigation. Other zoom continuations used existing visible fixed HUD route coordinate, not a new scene target.
method.boundaries: Every returned screenshot viewed before dependent adaptive input in a separate tool call. Requested waits<=3000ms; inspected shortened waits and did not bypass boundaries. No checkpoints, third attempt, keyboard, mouse or evaluation.
